newsitem.title: USA: State Street Boston Corp to change name.
newsitem.headline: State Street Boston Corp to change name.

text.p: State Street Boston Corp said Wednesday it will change its name to State Street Corp and begin its first television advertising campaign in its history as part of a new branding strategy.
Neither the effective date of the name change nor the start date of the advertising campaign were immediately available.
The company said that strategy reflects its transformation into a global institution and its ability to serve institutional investors worldwide.
State Street has $300 billion in assets under management, $3 trillion in assets under custody, and customers in 77 nations.
Reached later for comment, the company said that the name change will take effect April 16, pending shareholder approval.
The company also said that print ads would begin appearing Mar 13, and television ads would begin airing Mar 16 on CNN, CBS and other stations.
